requirements.quote: a) Contain every line that appears at least once in the original list.

check.cmd: test -f /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt && sort -u /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.txt | while IFS= read -r l; do grep -qxF -- "$l" /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt || echo "MISSING $l"; done

requirements.quote: b) No line may be repeated.

c) Lines must be ordered lexicographically (the same order produced by the GNU
      `sort` utility with no extra options other than “unique” handling).
d) The file must end with exactly one trailing newline and **no extra blank lines**.

check.cmd: ! grep -q '^$' /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt && test -s /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt && [ "$(tail -c1 /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" = 0a ] && [ "$(tail -c2 /home/user/backup/files_to_backup.sorted.txt | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" != 0a0a ]

requirements.quote:
The entry must be exactly (including the period and newline at the end):

   files_to_backup.sorted.txt generated.
Do not move, rename, or delete the original files_to_backup.txt file.
Finally, remove the `/srv/basalt` directory tree. We need the space.
